en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a formal city park with walking paths, statues, and a small domed pavilion on the left, and a large historic building with arched gateway on the right. Many people, including what appears to be a marching band or troop, walk along the path by the building. The front bears red printed captions "Pécs" and "Sétatér". The reverse side is a divided back with Hungarian text, a green Hungarian stamp marked "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA", and handwritten message and address.
